correctness.rationale: Checking the associative Nijenhuis identity on basis pairs of A=F_q 1⊕V with V²=0 forces radical-to-scalar functional f=0 (since f(v)^2=0 in every field) and T w=λ w; these equations are sufficient. The raw count is q[q^{n²}+(q^n-1)q^{n(n-1)}]. Algebra automorphisms are GL(V), reducing conjugacy to similarity T with a marked λ-eigenvector w. The centralizer acts transitively on each nonzero socle stratum with smallest occupied λ-Jordan block size; zero adds one orbit. Weighting each λ-primary partition by one plus number of distinct part sizes multiplies the matrix-similarity generating function K_q(z)=prod_{j>=1}(1-qz^j)^-1 by 1/(1-z), then by q scalars. Independently enumerated F_2 two-dimensional T and admissible w: 56 raw operators. Source verifier read and finite orbit totals corroborate but cannot prove all finite fields.
